name: [RELEASE] Dystovia
desc:
Step into Dystovia, an Adventure RPG set in a huge open world where you master swordsmanship against the many creatures the world has to offer, traverse many biomes, take on thrilling quests and defeat the toughest bosses and dungeons the world has to offer! 

🌎 20+ Biomes across the vast world
☠️ 6 Crypts/Dungeons containing unique loot 
⚔️ 200+ Equipment pieces you can unlock

🌟 Keep up with updates and announcements on our groups and socials.

⭐️Any donations as well as simply favoriting the game is greatly appreciated and motivates us to continue development!

📱 💻 🎮 Available across mobile, tablet, computer and console

Version: V1.0.0
